_what_this_is: The maintainer decision that permits ONE Phase-C1 paid session. It is an INPUT to scripts/autoinit/issue_c1_authorization.py, which derives every identity — session commit, harness digest, isolation plan hash, science plan, preregistration, battery, teacher, scoring contract, ceiling — from the committed objects and REFUSES if this document asserts any of them. Reviewed and granted at HEAD d71ad2e7e2d18a59bc786dc743348cb3511c8363.
granted_by: maintainer, final C1 grant review: GO on the frozen runnable C1 session at d71ad2e7e2d18a59bc786dc743348cb3511c8363
covers: Phase C1 fixed-path ATTENTION isolation: 2 arms x 3 fresh recovery seeds = 6 total 0.86M probes, one evaluation per completed probe on c1_confirmation_v1, and the frozen paired C1 decision. One grant, consumed by exactly one issuance, one launch attempt. No automatic retry, no second attempt, no automatic ceiling increase.
cap_note: The project cumulative cap remains $283.7600 and is NOT raised by this grant. $19.9003 was uncommitted at approval; the $13.7578 ceiling leaves $6.1425.

failure_semantics.replay_mismatch: stop before recovery training; preserve the replay evidence; it is the attempt's result; no automatic retry
failure_semantics.recovery_training_failure: C1_INCOMPLETE; do not proceed to a partial confirmation experiment
failure_semantics.generation_admission_failure: preserve raw generations and the admission record; do not score that probe; do not evaluate a later probe; do not run stage I
failure_semantics.stage_i_precondition: six complete admitted and scored probe results
failure_semantics.no_forced_conclusion: an incomplete session yields no scientific conclusion

after_termination: complete evidence recovery as far as the session contract permits, verify provider termination via the authoritative GraphQL pod check, and do not start C2 regardless of the C1 verdict.
